new: (operational_doc §30, the cost of a live run), in one line. WHY THE ORACLE LOST: the primary objective of every run is to determine why the Debate Oracle is losing rounds; errors in the system are the second objective. For each round or link the Debate Oracle lost: what the judges held against it, in the judges' own lines; the round text it answered or failed to answer; and the cause, named as the Oracle's argument, a judge's misreading, or the engine. The rounds of both sides and the judgment of every seat that sat are read whole before this part is written. A run in which the Debate Oracle lost no round or link reads NONE LOST. The causes stated here are carried forward as the stated primary objective of the next run, and the next run's report states for each cause whether it recurred. OBJECTIVE: for each ASK
